title: Nazi expeditions to the Himalayas in search of Aryan myths
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Nazi expeditions to the Himalayas in search of Aryan myths, about 1930s-1940s at Himalayas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I think it was Whitowski who um who uh described their expeditions to the Himalayas in search of these Aryan myths

plain: Kirk McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, recalls that a Polish writer named Igor Witkowski described Nazi expeditions to the Himalayas in the 1930s and 1940s. According to McConnell, the Nazis went there searching for evidence of their "Aryan" myths, legends about the ancient origins of a supposed master race, which in his telling ties Nazi research to ancient lore.
